terms.title: Terms of Use
terms.section1Text: Welcome to mineuqr platform. By using this website and services provided through it, you agree to comply with these Terms of Use. Please read these terms carefully before using the platform. If you do not agree to any of these terms, please do not use our services.
terms.section2Text: mineuqr is an electronic service that enables restaurants, cafes, and food establishments to create digital menus that can be accessed via QR codes. The service includes creating and managing digital menus, categorizing items, uploading item images, generating unique QR codes, and providing a display page for customers.
terms.section3Text1: To use our services, you must create an account through the available authentication system. You are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of your account data and for all activities conducted through it. You must notify us immediately of any unauthorized use of your account.
terms.section3Text2: We reserve the right to suspend or terminate your account if you violate these terms or provide false or misleading information.
terms.section4Text1: The platform offers a free trial period of 14 days for all new users. After the trial period ends, you must subscribe to one of the paid plans to continue using the service. Plans differ in terms of the number of restaurants, items, and available features.
terms.section4Text2: Subscriptions are automatically renewed at the end of each billing cycle (monthly or yearly) unless canceled before the renewal date. You can cancel your subscription at any time, and your account will remain active until the end of the current paid period.
terms.section5Text1: Payments are made through the PayPal gateway or by direct contact with the support team via email. All prices are displayed in US dollars and may be subject to local taxes depending on your country of residence.
terms.section5Text2: If you are not satisfied with the service within the first 7 days of paid subscription, you can request a full refund by contacting the support team. After this period, no refunds will be issued.
terms.section6Text1: You retain ownership of all content you upload to the platform, including images, texts, and descriptions. By uploading content, you grant us a non-exclusive license to use and display it within the scope of providing the service only.
terms.section6Text2: You represent and warrant that the content you upload does not infringe on the intellectual property rights of any third party and does not contain illegal, offensive, or misleading material.
terms.section7Text: The platform must be used for lawful purposes only and in compliance with applicable laws. It is prohibited to use the platform to publish illegal or offensive content, attempt unauthorized access to our systems, send malware or viruses, or use the service in a way that negatively affects the platform's performance or other users' experience.
terms.section8Text1: The service is provided as is without any express or implied warranties. We do not guarantee that the service will be continuously available or error-free. We are not liable for any direct or indirect damages resulting from the use of the platform.
terms.section8Text2: We reserve the right to modify or suspend any part of the service at any time with reasonable prior notice.
terms.section9Text: We reserve the right to modify these terms at any time. You will be notified of any material changes via email or through a notice on the platform. Your continued use of the service after posting modifications means you agree to the modified terms.
terms.section10Text: If you have any questions or inquiries about these Terms of Use, you can contact us via email at

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.section1Text: We at mineuqr are committed to protecting your privacy and personal data. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, and protect the information you provide when using our platform. By using the platform, you agree to the practices outlined in this policy.
privacy.section2Text1: We collect various types of data to provide and improve our services. The personal data we collect includes: name and email address when creating an account, restaurant information such as name, address, and description, and menu data including item names, descriptions, prices, and images.
privacy.section2Text2: We also automatically collect technical data including IP address, browser type, and operating system, usage data such as pages visited and session duration, and cookies to improve your experience.
privacy.section3Text: We use the collected data to provide and operate the digital menu service, process payment and subscription transactions, send important notifications about your account and our services, improve platform performance and user experience, provide technical support and respond to your inquiries, and protect the platform from unauthorized use.
privacy.section4Text1: We do not sell your personal data to any third party. We may share your data only in the following cases: with trusted service providers who help us operate the platform such as hosting services, file storage (Amazon S3), and payment gateway (PayPal), when responding to legal requirements or court orders, and in case of merger or acquisition with prior notice.
privacy.section4Text2: Menu data (item names, descriptions, prices, and images) is displayed to customers who scan your restaurant's QR code, which is an essential part of the service nature.
privacy.section5Text1: We take appropriate security measures to protect your data from unauthorized access, modification, disclosure, or destruction. These measures include encrypting data in transit using HTTPS protocol, storing images on secure Amazon S3 servers, and using a secure authentication system to protect accounts.
privacy.section5Text2: Your data is stored on secure servers and retained throughout your account's active period. If you delete your account, your personal data will be deleted within 30 days, while retaining legally required data.
privacy.section6Text: We use cookies to improve your experience on the platform. Essential cookies are required for login and session management, and analytical cookies help us understand how the platform is used and improve it. You can control cookie settings through your browser settings, although disabling some may affect platform functionality.
privacy.section7Text: You have the right to access your personal data stored with us, correct any inaccurate data, request deletion of your personal data, object to processing your data for certain purposes, and request a copy of your data in a readable format. To exercise any of these rights, please contact us via email.
privacy.section8Text: Our services are not directed to persons under 18 years of age. We do not intentionally collect personal data from children. If we become aware that we have collected data from a minor, we will delete it immediately.
privacy.section9Text: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. We will notify you of any material changes via email or through a prominent notice on the platform. We encourage you to review this policy periodically for any updates.
privacy.section10Text: If you have any questions or concerns about this Privacy Policy or our data practices, you can contact us via email at

hero.title: Transforming Digital Menu Experience
hero.description: mineuqr is a comprehensive platform for creating and managing digital menus with QR Code technology. We empower restaurants and cafes to deliver a professional, seamless digital experience to their customers, with multiple designs and full Arabic and English language support.

vision.title: Our Vision
vision.description: To make mineuqr the leading digital menu platform in the Middle East, delivering smart solutions that combine simplicity and professionalism, with multi-language support and an exceptional user experience.

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.description: Empower every restaurant and cafe to create a professional digital menu in minutes, without any technical expertise. We provide easy-to-use tools with diverse templates and full color and font customization.

values.title: Our Values
values.subtitle: That Set Us Apart
values.description: We believe in delivering real value to every customer through our core principles

innovation.title: Innovation
innovation.desc: We continuously develop new features like multiple templates, color and font customization, and a smart offers system to meet the evolving needs of the restaurant industry.

simplicity.title: Simplicity
simplicity.desc: We designed mineuqr to be easy to use from the very first moment. Create your digital menu in minutes without any technical expertise.

reliability.title: Reliability
reliability.desc: We are committed to the highest standards of security and stability. Your digital menu is available 24/7 with complete protection for your data and your customers' data.

customer.title: Customer First
customer.desc: We prioritize customer satisfaction with fast technical support via WhatsApp and email around the clock.

timeline.title: The
timeline.subtitle: mineuqr Journey
timeline.description: From a simple idea to a comprehensive digital menu platform

2024.title: The Birth of an Idea
2024.desc: The mineuqr journey began with a simple idea: transform paper menus into a smart, seamless digital experience suited for the digital transformation era.

2025.title: Launch and Growth
2025.desc: We launched the platform with advanced features: 8 professional templates, full color and font customization, subscription system, and bilingual Arabic/English support.

2026.title: Expansion and Leadership
2026.desc: We aspire to reach thousands of restaurants across the Arab region with new features like direct ordering and payment system integration.
